description: Removes a calendar from the user's calendar list, unsubscribing from it without deleting the calendar itself.

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the 'primary' keyword.
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the ID of the calendar you want to remove from your calendar list. You can use 'primary' for your main calendar or provide a specific calendar ID.
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

name: calendar_list_delete

message.description: Optional confirmation message indicating the calendar list entry removal status (e.g., 'Calendar removed from list successfully.'). Not part of the official API response; may be added by client/tooling.
message.title: Message
